tiles: Where negative space does most of the work
The pieces that stayed with me
challenge: A lot of what I love about Bauhaus design is that it trusts the viewer — it leaves room. I wanted to push that further and see what I could learn about minimalism by trying to make pieces where almost nothing is there and everything still feels considered.
approach: I read into the minimalist lineage and the Bauhaus ideas it borrows from, then drafted variations, cutting and cutting until each one felt like it couldn't lose anything else. I kept the ones that taught me something about restraint, and that I liked living with.
result: This set is small, quiet, and calm — the pieces where the negative space felt like the point. I made them available as prints in case anyone else enjoys that same kind of quiet on a wall.
